mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending capacity and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) over the prior 1 month indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 1 month signals an imminent economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines in the late-cycle regime, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months signals strengthening consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals overheating that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL (YoY) exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 6 months indicates broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL (YoY) > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
